hrr-force.intro: Bold, sporty and ready for anything. The Force set pairs a full-sleeve T-shirt with a big "Force" graphic and classic washed blue jeans, so your little one gets a complete outfit in one go, no mixing and matching needed.
highlights: Eye-catching "Force" graphic on the chest
Full sleeves for cooler mornings and evenings
Washed blue jeans that go with almost everything
Comes in Beige, Cherry and Gold
hrr-force.sizeNote: Sizes run by age. If your child is between sizes, pick the larger one for a comfortable fit.

hrr-g-racing.intro: Made for kids who never slow down. A racing-inspired print and a contrast neckline give this full-sleeve T-shirt a sporty edge, while the washed blue jeans keep the look relaxed and easy.
highlights: Racing-themed print with a contrast neckline
Full-sleeve T-shirt for all-day cover
Matching washed jeans included in the set
Choose Pink, Light Green or Light Blue
hrr-g-racing.sizeNote: Sizes run by age. Between sizes? Go one up so there's room to play.

hrr-beach.intro: A bright red full-sleeve tee that's impossible to miss, paired with dark blue jeans for a smart contrast. Great for outings, family visits and weekend fun.
highlights: Vibrant red printed T-shirt
Dark blue jeans for a neat, put-together look
Full sleeves for extra cover
A complete two-piece outfit
hrr-beach.sizeNote: Sizes run by age. For a roomier fit, choose the next size up.

hrr-london.intro: Light, fresh and easy to wear. A sky-blue printed full-sleeve T-shirt meets dark blue jeans in a calm, classic combination that works for school outings and family days alike.
highlights: Soft sky-blue printed T-shirt
Dark blue jeans for an easy, classic pairing
Full sleeves for all-day comfort
Now available from 18-24 months
hrr-london.sizeNote: Sizes run by age. If in doubt, pick the larger size.

hrr-chasma.intro: Party-ready with a playful twist. This set teams a pink cold-shoulder top with a fun sunglasses print and colourful printed shorts, perfect for birthdays, festive get-togethers and holiday photos.
highlights: Pink top with a sunglasses print
Trendy cold-shoulder sleeves
Colourful printed shorts
A ready-to-wear two-piece set
hrr-chasma.sizeNote: Sizes run by age. For a relaxed fit, choose one size up.

hrr-pink-hat.intro: Bright, cheerful and easy to move in. A pink sleeveless printed top pairs with denim shorts for a fun look that works just as well at a party as on a sunny day out.
highlights: Sleeveless pink top with a playful print
Denim shorts for a casual, cool finish
Light and comfortable for warm days
Two pieces, one complete look
hrr-pink-hat.sizeNote: Sizes run by age. Between sizes? The larger one gives more room to grow.

hrr-blue-style.intro: A twirl-worthy dress with a smart, layered look. The navy 3/4-sleeve top flows into a flared pink checked pinafore skirt that falls to calf length: dressy enough for occasions, easy enough for everyday wear.
highlights: Layered pinafore-style design
Flared, calf-length checked skirt
3/4 sleeves in contrasting navy
Now available up to 9-10 yrs
hrr-blue-style.sizeNote: Sizes run by age. Calf-length styles look best when the size matches your child's age, so check the length before sizing up.

ftc-pink-midi.intro: Fresh gingham charm for sunny days and special occasions. A white sleeveless bodice sits under a pink gingham overlay, finished with a tiered gingham skirt that swishes with every step.
highlights: Classic pink and white gingham
Tiered skirt with a playful swing
Sleeveless design for warmer days
Now available up to 9-10 yrs
ftc-pink-midi.sizeNote: Sizes run by age. If your child is tall for their age, consider the next size up.

hrr-unisex-peach-mustard.intro: Two everyday outfits in one pack. A peach and a mustard printed T-shirt, each paired with maroon shorts, make this set ideal for siblings, twins or simply having a spare outfit ready for play.
highlights: Pack of 2 T-shirt and shorts sets
Peach and mustard printed T-shirts
Maroon shorts that match both tees
Great for boys and girls alike
hrr-unisex-peach-mustard.sizeNote: Sizes run by age, now up to 9-10 yrs. The size you choose applies to both sets in the pack.

hrr-unisex-ride-classic.intro: Vintage car vibes for little road-trippers. This pack of two brings a peach and a red "Ride Classic" T-shirt with aqua and black shorts, easy to mix and match through the week.
highlights: Pack of 2 T-shirt and shorts sets
"Ride Classic" car print on both tees
Aqua and black shorts to mix and match
A fun pick for boys and girls
hrr-unisex-ride-classic.sizeNote: Sizes run by age, now up to 9-10 yrs. Both sets in the pack come in the size you choose.

hrr-unisex-bicycle.intro: For kids who love to pedal. Two bicycle-print T-shirts in peach and red, paired with black and mint shorts, make this pack a cheerful choice for playdates, outings and everyday comfort.
highlights: Pack of 2 T-shirt and shorts sets
Playful bicycle print on both tees
Black and mint shorts for easy pairing
Designed for boys and girls
hrr-unisex-bicycle.sizeNote: Sizes run by age, now up to 9-10 yrs. One size choice covers both sets in the pack.
